mapper.select: SELECT r.id FROM brain_manuscript_review r WHERE r.initiator_user_id = #{currentUserId} ORDER BY r.id

SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(i.business_id) FROM flow_task t INNER JOIN flow_user u ON u.associated = t.id INNER JOIN flow_instance i ON t.instance_id = i.id INNER JOIN flow_definition d ON t.definition_id = d.id WHERE t.node_type = 1 AND t.del_flag = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' AND u.type IN ('1', '2', '3') AND u.processed_by = #{currentUserId} AND i.flow_status = 'WAITING' AND d.flow_code = 'manuscript_review_' AND i.business_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(i.business_id) <> ''

SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(i.business_id) FROM flow_his_task h INNER JOIN flow_instance i ON h.instance_id = i.id INNER JOIN flow_definition d ON h.definition_id = d.id WHERE h.node_type = 1 AND h.del_flag = '0' AND i.del_flag = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0' AND h.approver = #{currentUserId} AND d.flow_code = 'manuscript_review_' AND i.business_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(i.business_id) <> ''

SELECT r.* FROM brain_manuscript_review r
AND r.id IN
#{reviewId}
AND ( r.manuscript_code LIKE concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR r.external_manuscript_code LIKE concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR r.title LIKE concat('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
AND r.process_type = #{query.processType}
AND r.media_channel = #{query.mediaChannel}
AND r.flow_status_label = '审批中'
AND r.flow_status_label = '已退回'
AND r.flow_status_label IN ('已完成', '流程完成')
AND r.flow_status_label IN ('已取消', '流程已取消')
AND r.flow_status_label IN ('已驳回', '流程已驳回')
AND (r.current_node_status = 'LEVEL_1' OR r.current_node_label IN ('待一级审批', '一级审批'))
AND (r.current_node_status = 'LEVEL_2' OR r.current_node_label IN ('待二级审批', '二级审批'))
AND (r.current_node_status = 'LEVEL_3' OR r.current_node_label IN ('待三级审批', '三级审批', '终审'))
AND (r.current_node_status = 'RETURN_TO_INITIATOR' OR r.current_node_label = '待发起人处理')
AND COALESCE(r.first_submit_time, r.create_time) >= #{startTimeFrom}
AND COALESCE(r.first_submit_time, r.create_time) <= #{startTimeTo}
ORDER BY COALESCE(r.update_time, r.create_time) DESC, r.create_time DESC, r.id DESC
